**Overall Assessment:**

While the company has demonstrated a very large turn around in Net income, its substantial drop in cash position and increase in other liabilities raises some concerns. The positive sales growth, coupled with improved operating and net profit margins, is very encouraging, but the lower cash balance needs close monitoring.
